label: The meditator bears an occurring idea that represents INFINITE_3
paraphrase: P1 of the idea-of-the-infinite argument, analyst formulation (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III; attribution deferred): some occurring episode e is borne by the meditator and represents the infinite, i.e. presents the perfection of infinite substance (INFINITE_3) as its content. First-person and existential: about one idea of the designated meditator. Representing the infinite is not being in act in it. Open.
